usdRate.note: 2025 average official rate. The Bank of Jamaica FX spot trading summary (boj.org.jm/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/FX-Press-Summary-1.pdf) gave a weighted average USD selling rate of J$159.55 for 2 November 2026, after the cut-off date, so the World Bank figure is kept.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: headline inflation (RS.INF.01, STATIN CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: 12-month point-to-point inflation 8.59% in September 2026, up from 7.86% in August; above the 4-6% target range.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: inflation target and outturn (RS.INF.00), target 4-6%
inflation_projection.note: The BOJ targets 4-6% and fiscal-year outturns were 4.3-6.2% in 2022/23-2025/26 apart from 2021/22, so we plan with the 5% mid-point despite the 2026 spike.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: Monetary Policy Press Release, September 2026
policy_rate.note: Raised by 50 basis points from 5.50% on 24-25 September 2026, effective 29 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average rate on savings deposits, September 2026 (0.969%).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Weighted average rate on time deposits of 3 to less than 6 months, September 2026 (1 to 3 months: 4.58%).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Weighted average rate on time deposits of 12 months and over, September 2026 (6 to 12 months: 4.92%).

dps_rate.note: No official series for monthly recurring deposits was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Overall weighted average rate on all local-currency deposits (time 4.63%, savings 0.97%, demand 1.14%), September 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond sold directly to individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: Government of Jamaica Treasury bill yields (IR.GOJ.00)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Average 3-month (88-93 day) Treasury bill tender yield, October 2026; 6-month 5.97%.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Government of Jamaica bond yield was found in the BOJ tables read.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Government of Jamaica bond yield was found in the BOJ tables read.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Jamaica, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 25% withheld at source by banks and other prescribed financial institutions; the interest is then taxed at 25% or 30% with credit for the tax withheld.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found, so no tax rate applies to report.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: J$1,200,000 per depositor per institution, principal and interest; the page gives no effective date.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or official average credit card rate was found; BOJ loan-rate tables give personal credit at 24.6% (August 2026) but not cards.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica Treasury bill yields (IR.GOJ.00); Jamaica Stock Exchange record
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for local shares, as after 2019.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica Treasury bill yields: 3-month 5.46%, about 4.1% after 25% tax
equity_return_base.note: Base case within the after-tax T-bill rate plus 4 points, as the local index has been flat to weak since its 2019 peak.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Jamaica Stock Exchange record; global equities in Jamaican dollar terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: a strong decade like 2015-2019.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with mild depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price; JMD exchange rate trend
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4.5% a year plus about 2% Jamaican dollar depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: 1-3 month deposits at about 4.4-4.6%, less 25% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica Treasury bill yields (IR.GOJ.00) and deposit rates
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 3-month T-bills at 5.46% and 3-12 month deposits near 4.9%, less 25% withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica Treasury bill yields (IR.GOJ.00)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case if yields rise after the September 2026 policy rate increase.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from the Financial Services Commission was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age from the regulator or another permitted source were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No public premium table for private health insurance by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No health price index rate was read; private care tends to outpace headline, so we plan with 1.5 points above the 5% target mid-point.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index rate was read; tuition usually rises faster than headline, so we plan with 6%.

life_expectancy.note: Men 69.1, women 74.1 (2024). UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 71.9 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projections for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 11.73 (2025, World Bank), 20.2 (2040) and 52.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/jamaica/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Insurance Act (with amendments to 2016), section 3(2): retirement age
retirement_age_default.note: NIS retirement age 65 for men; for women it rose a year at a time from 60 (to March 2011) to 64 (April 2014 to March 2015) and then 65. Older than 2025: consolidated text of April 2018.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Jamaica Information Service: House approves pension reform for public officers (8 May 2025)
retirement_age_government.note: Under the Pensions (Public Service) Act the retirement age rose gradually from 60 to 65 between April 2018 and April 2023; public officers retire at 65 from April 2023.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after 25% tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica: commercial banks' domestic currency deposit rates (IR.CB.00)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at the after-tax 1-year deposit rate (4.67% in September 2026 less 25% tax = 3.5%), below the after-tax 3-month T-bill rate of about 4.1%.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Jamaica Treasury bill yields (IR.GOJ.00)
retirement_return_high.note: High case with 6-month T-bills near 6% before tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BOJ deposit and T-bill rates; Jamaica Stock Exchange record
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of T-bills, deposits and shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: BOJ deposit and T-bill rates; Jamaica Stock Exchange record
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half equities at 7.5% and half fixed income at 4%, rounded.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: BOJ deposit and T-bill rates; Jamaica Stock Exchange record

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Jamaica Information Service: Nearly 15,000 seniors registered on the Social Pension Programme (31 May 2024)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social Pension paid every two months: J$12,000 per payment from May 2024 (up from J$6,800), i.e. J$6,000 a month; the article says 'bimonthly' and the earlier J$6,800 equals two months of the original J$3,400. Older than 2025; no later amount found (the JIS article of September 2025 gives no amount).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Jamaica Information Service: 16,000 Jamaicans now registered under Govt's Social Pension Programme (22 September 2025)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Citizens aged 75 and older who receive no pension (local or overseas), other retirement, disability or regular income support, are not on PATH and do not live in a government care facility.

gratuity_rule.note: Redundancy pay exists under the Employment (Termination and Redundancy Payments) Act, but no readable official source giving the weeks-per-year formula was found; there is no general statutory gratuity on retirement or resignation in the sources read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Ministry of Labour and Social Security: National Insurance Scheme
public_pension_scheme.note: NIS: employee and employer each pay 3% of pay up to J$5 million a year (PwC, reviewed 29 Sept 2026); flat-rate old-age pension J$4,200 a week (full rate) from 1 April 2023, raised by periodic decisions rather than automatic indexation; a J$60,000 grant if contribution conditions are not met. Older than 2025.

savings_account.note: Average savings rate about 1%; interest taxed at 25% at source.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond is sold directly to individuals.

tbill_91d.note: Sold at Bank of Jamaica tenders.

tbond_5y.note: Government of Jamaica local-currency bonds are traded; no yield found.

tbond_10y.note: Government of Jamaica local-currency bonds are traded; no yield found.

equity_fund.note: Collective investment schemes are supervised by the Financial Services Commission.

gold.note: Gold jewellery and coins can be bought from jewellers.

pensionScheme.name: National Insurance Scheme (NIS), Ministry of Labour and Social Security

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Pension Programme, Ministry of Labour and Social Security
oldAgeAllowance.note: For citizens 75 and older without a pension or other income support.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Wellness (public health services)
